title.en: An Act Declaring November 12 of Every Year A Special Non-working Holiday In the City of Valenzuela, In Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring November 12 of Every Year A Special Non-working Holiday In the City of Valenzuela, In Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 12 tháng 11 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Valenzuela, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 12 พฤศจิกายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเมือง Valenzuela เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 12 November setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kota Valenzuela, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 12 November setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Bandar Valenzuela, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12200_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: November 12 of very year is hereby declared a special non-working holiday in the City of Valenzuela, in commemoration of its foundation anniversary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
